content: schema.org: 'club' is explicitly listed as a canonical LocalBusiness example type. Organization is for brand/entity-level info with no physical premises; LocalBusiness (a subtype of Organization) is correct once there's a physical address/geo/opening-hours members can visit - which matches a Jujuy club with a real meeting location already shown via a Maps embed on the About page. Recommend @type LocalBusiness (or SportsActivityLocation/subtype if a closer fit exists) sitewide, with address, geo, and areaServed set to Jujuy, rather than Organization.
